Message:
serial: 8250_pci: make pciserial_detach_ports() static

Fixes the following sparse warning:

drivers/tty/serial/8250/8250_pci.c:3916:6: warning:
 symbol 'pciserial_detach_ports' was not declared. Should it be static?
